title: Ride Together (MCA + Immersive Vehicles)
description: Automatically lets Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn companions ride with you in Immersive Vehicles instead of running behind your vehicle.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0VZNskqqME8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>🚗 Ride Together (MCA + Immersive Vehicles)  
Travel together, just as it should be.  

Have you ever wished your Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn spouse, children, or companions would ride with you instead of desperately running after your vehicle?  

Ride Together is a lightweight compatibility addon that seamlessly integrates Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn with Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV), allowing your companions to automatically board your vehicle and occupy an available passenger seat whenever they're following you.  

No configuration. No commands. Just get in and drive.  

✨ Features  
🚗 Automatically seats nearby MCA companions that are following you.  
💺 Uses the first available passenger seat.  
👨‍👩‍👧 Only companions following you will board your vehicle.  
⚡ Lightweight and optimized for performance.  
🌍 Works in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.  
🧩 Designed to integrate naturally without modifying the gameplay of either mod.  
🔧 No configuration required.  

**📦 Requirements**  
Minecraft 1.20.1  
Minecraft Forge 47.3.0+  
Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn 7.6.26+  
Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV) 24.0.0+  
Architectury API  

**🚙 How It Works**  
Set an MCA companion to Follow.  
Enter any Immersive Vehicles vehicle with at least one free passenger seat.  
Your companion will automatically board the vehicle and take the first available seat.  

**_To have your companion leave the vehicle:_**  

Right-click the companion.  
Select Interact.  
Click Ride Horse.  

MCA will automatically make the companion dismount the vehicle.  

That's it!  

**🤝 Compatibility**  

Ride Together is designed to be as lightweight and non-invasive as possible.  

It does not replace or modify the gameplay of Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn or Immersive Vehicles. Instead, it simply bridges both mods by allowing companions to occupy available passenger seats automatically.  

The addon is intended to work alongside most Forge 1.20.1 modpacks and addons.  

As long as another mod doesn't replace or heavily modify the internal behavior of Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn or Immersive Vehicles, Ride Together should remain fully compatible.  

**❤️ Why this addon?**  

Watching your spouse, children, or companions chase your truck, bus, or car across the world never felt immersive.  

Ride Together solves that with a simple quality-of-life improvement that makes traveling together feel natural.  

Whether you're exploring new lands, transporting your family, or simply driving around your world, your companions can finally ride together with you.

MIT License  

Feel free to include this mod in public or private modpacks.  

🚀 Version 1.0.0  
Initial release.  
Automatic vehicle boarding for MCA companions following the player.  
Supports Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn 7.6.26+.  
Supports Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV) 24.0.0+.  
Multiplayer compatible.  
Lightweight compatibility addon.
